title: Using AWS Step Functions to query Amazon Athena Amazon S3 data
description: Using Step Functions to query Athena S3 data.

introBox.headline: How it works:
text: This serverless pattern uses Amazon Athena allows to analyze data in Amazon S3 using standard SQL.
A Glue crawler creates a database table from the S3 data which is queried by Athena.
Step Functionsis leveraged to query as well as process each result in this data received from Athena with the help of **NextToken**.
